content.text:
Validation of the Föderales Entwicklungsportal installation is complete. The installation is assessed as SUCCESS.

Key findings:
- Toolchain matches guide: node v22.17.0, npm 10.9.2, yarn 1.22.22 installed and functional.
- /workspace/node_modules complete (557 packages); /workspace/build contains the full static export: 192 prerendered HTML pages (de/, en/, fit-standards/, resources/), search-data JSON, robots.txt, _next assets with all referenced assets present.
- `yarn dev` started successfully (Next.js 16.3.4, Ready in ~1s); live curl to /, /de/, /en/, /fit-standards/, /resources/meta/ all returned HTTP 200 with the expected page title.
- `yarn start` (npx serve@latest build) served the production export on port 3000; all key routes and assets returned HTTP 200, locales render with correct lang attributes, unknown paths return 404.
- Test servers were stopped afterward; port 3000 confirmed free.

Limitations: client-side interactivity not exercised in a browser; .env.local absent (Plausible variables have documented defaults, no functional impact).
